'''Tajihi no Miyake Maro''' (多治比三宅麻呂) was a noble of late {{ill|Asuka period|ar|فترة أسوكا|be|Перыяд Асука|bg|Асука|bn|আসুকা যুগ|ca|Període Asuka|cs|Období Asuka|de|Asuka-Zeit|eo|Asuka-epoko|es|Período Asuka|eu|Asuka aroa|fa|دوره آسوکا|fi|Asuka-kausi|fr|Période d'Asuka|he|תקופת אסוקה|hr|Asuka (razdoblje)|hu|Aszuka-kor|id|Zaman Asuka|it|Periodo Asuka|ja|飛鳥時代|ko|아스카 시대|lt|Asuka laikotarpis|ms|Zaman Asuka|nl|Asukaperiode|nn|Asuka|no|Asuka|pl|Asuka (okres)|pt|Período Asuka|ru|Период Асука|sh|Asuka period|simple|Asuka period|sk|Obdobie Asuka|sl|Obdobje Asuka|sq|Periudha Asuka|sr|Асука период|sv|Asuka|th|ยุคอาซูกะ|tl|Panahong Asuka|tr|Asuka Dönemi|uk|Період Асука|vi|Thời kỳ Asuka|zh|飛鳥時代|zh_classical|飛鳥時代|zh_min_nan|Asuka sî-tāi|zh_yue|飛鳥時代|qid=Q210688|lt=Asuka period}} to early {{ill|Nara period|af|Nara-tydperk|ar|فترة نارا|bcl|Panahon nin Nara|bg|Нара (период)|bn|নারা যুগ|ca|Període Nara|ckb|سەردەمی نارا|cs|Období Nara|de|Nara-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Νάρα|eo|Epoko de Nara|es|Período Nara|eu|Nara aroa|fa|دوره نارا|fi|Nara-kausi|fr|Époque de Nara|gl|Período Nara|he|תקופת נארה|hr|Nara (razdoblje)|hu|Nara-kor|id|Zaman Nara|it|Periodo Nara|ja|奈良時代|jv|Periodhe Nara|ko|나라 시대|lt|Nara laikotarpis|ml|നാറ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Nara|nl|Naraperiode|nn|Naratida|no|Nara-perioden|oc|Periòde de Nara|pl|Nara (okres)|ps|نارا|pt|Período Nara|ro|Perioada Nara|ru|Период Нара|sh|Nara period|simple|Nara period|sk|Obdobie Nara|sl|Obdobje Nara|sr|Нара период|sv|Naraperioden|th|ยุคนาระ|tl|Panahong Nara|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Nala|tr|Nara Dönemi|uk|Період Нара|ur|نارا دور|vi|Thời kỳ Nara|war|Panahon Nara|wuu|奈良时代|zh|奈良時代|zh_min_nan|Nara sî-tāi|zh_yue|奈良時代|qid=Q189178|lt=Nara period}}. He was the son of {{ill|Tajihi no Koō|ja|多治比古王}}, the governor of {{ill|Settsu Province|en|Settsu Province|qid=Q864163|lt=Settsu Province}}, and held the Rank of {{ill|Senior Fourth Rank|ja|正四位}} and the position of {{ill|benkan|ja|弁官|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sadaiben|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3270768}} ({{ill|benkan|ja|左大弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Left Major Controller|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3270768}}).

== Career ==

After serving as a {{ill|Q97210018|ja|巡察使 (古代日本)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōsandō Circuit Inspector|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q97210018}} (巡察使), he was promoted in {{ill|Keiun|ar|فترة كيون|de|Keiun|es|Keiun|fa|کیوئون|fr|Ère Keiun|ia|Keiun|id|Keiun|ja|慶雲|ko|게이운|ru|Кэйун|simple|Keiun|sr|Кеиун|th|เคอุง|tr|Keiun|uk|Кей'ун|zh|慶雲 (日本)|zh_yue|慶雲 (日本)|qid=Q428753|lt=Keiun}} 1 (704) from {{ill|Junior Sixth Rank|ja|従六位|ko|종6위|zh|從六位|qid=Q14624983}} by three levels to {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位下|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}}. In {{ill|Keiun|ar|فترة كيون|de|Keiun|es|Keiun|fa|کیوئون|fr|Ère Keiun|ia|Keiun|id|Keiun|ja|慶雲|ko|게이운|ru|Кэйун|simple|Keiun|sr|Кеиун|th|เคอุง|tr|Keiun|uk|Кей'ун|zh|慶雲 (日本)|zh_yue|慶雲 (日本)|qid=Q428753|lt=Keiun}} 4 (707), he was assigned as {{ill|Q11626688|ja|装束司|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goshōzokushi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11626688}} (御装束司) following the death of {{ill|Emperor Monmu|en|Emperor Monmu|qid=Q357246|lt=Emperor Monmu}}.

During the reign of {{ill|Empress Genmei|ar|الإمبراطورة غيميه|az|İmperatriça Qenmey|azb|امپراتریس قمه‌ای|bcl|Emperatris Genmei|ca|Genmei|ckb|ئیمپڕاتۆر گێنمێی|cs|Gemmei|de|Gemmei|es|Emperatriz Genmei|fa|امپراتریس گنمی|fi|Genmei|fr|Genmei|he|גנמיי|hi|साम्राज्ञी गैमी|hu|Genmei japán császárnő|id|Maharani Genmei|it|Genmei|ja|元明天皇|ko|겐메이 천황|la|Gemmei (imperatrix)|ms|Maharani Genmei|nl|Genmei|oc|Genmei|pl|Gemmei|pt|Gemmei|ru|Императрица Гэммэй|sh|Carica Gemmei|simple|Empress Gemmei|sl|Cesarica Genmei|sv|Gemmei|ta|பேரரசி ஜென்மெய்|th|จักรพรรดินีเก็มเม|tl|Emperatris Gemmei|tr|Gemmei (imparatoriçe)|uk|Імператриця Ґеммей|vi|Thiên hoàng Genmei|zh|元明天皇|zh_classical|元明天皇|zh_min_nan|Genmei Thian-hông|zh_yue|元明天皇|qid=Q233224|lt=Empress Genmei}}, he was appointed to the newly established {{ill|Q11650312|ja|鋳銭司|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mint Bureau|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11650312}} and the {{ill|Zaōzatsumotsuhōyōshi|ja|造雑物法用司}}. He continued to advance, reaching {{ill|Senior Fifth Rank|ja|正五位上|lt=Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade}} in {{ill|Wadō (era)|ar|وادو (حقبة)|de|Wadō (Ära)|es|Wadō|fa|وادو (دوره)|fr|Ère Wadō|ia|Wado|id|Wadō|ja|和銅|ko|와도|pt|Wadō (era)|ru|Вадо|simple|Wadō (era)|sr|Вадо (ера)|th|วาโด|tr|Wadō|uk|Вадо (ненґо)|zh|和銅|zh_yue|和銅|qid=Q1373026|lt=Wadō}} 4 (711) and {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位下|lt=Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade}} in Wadō 6 (713) while serving in the {{ill|benkan|ja|弁官|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Controller's Office|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3270768}}. By the end of Empress Genmei's reign, in Wadō 8 (715), he attained {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位上|lt=Junior Fourth Rank, Upper Grade}} and was appointed {{ill|benkan|ja|左大弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sadaiben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3270768}}.

During the reign of {{ill|Empress Genshō|en|Empress Genshō|qid=Q235343|lt=Empress Genshō}}, he held the positions of {{ill|Q11547969|ja|民部卿|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Minbu-kyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11547969}} and {{ill|Kawachi Province Inspector|ja|河内国按察使 (日本)}}. He was promoted to {{ill|Senior Fourth Rank|ja|正四位下|lt=Senior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade}} in {{ill|Yōrō|en|Yōrō|qid=Q1373061|lt=Yōrō}} 3 (719) and to {{ill|Senior Fourth Rank|ja|正四位上|lt=Senior Fourth Rank, Upper Grade}} in Yōrō 5 (721). It is believed that in the same year, he was appointed as {{ill|Sangi (Japan)|en|Sangi (Japan)|qid=Q1133663|lt=Sangi}}, meaning the {{ill|Tajihi clan|ja|多治比氏|qid=Q11430839|lt=Tajihi clan}} had multiple members in the {{ill|Daijō-kan|en|Daijō-kan|qid=Q1192939|lt=Daijō-kan}} council, similar to the {{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|qid=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}.

However, in Yōrō 6 (722), he was accused of treason and sentenced to death. His execution was reduced to exile in {{ill|Izu Province|en|Izu Province|qid=Q860928|lt=Izu Province}} through the petition of {{ill|Emperor Shōmu|ja|首皇子|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Prince Obito|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 聖武天皇|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q349263}}, the future {{ill|Emperor Shōmu|en|Emperor Shōmu|qid=Q349263|lt=Emperor Shōmu}}.<ref>『{{ill|Shoku Nihongi|en|Shoku Nihongi|qid=Q611399|lt=Shoku Nihongi}}』Yōrō 6, 1st Month, 20th Day entry</ref> Some theories suggest that this was a political maneuver by {{ill|Prince Nagaya|en|Prince Nagaya|qid=Q1963492|lt=Nagaya no Ōkimi}}, who opposed the {{ill|Fujiwara Four Brothers|ja|藤原四兄弟}}, to replace Miyake Maro with his ally {{ill|Abe no Hironiwa|en|Abe no Hironiwa|qid=Q11657244|lt=Abe no Hiromaro}}, thereby consolidating power in the {{ill|Daijō-kan|en|Daijō-kan|qid=Q1192939|lt=Daijō-kan}}.<ref>{{ill|Yoshinobu Kimoto|ja|木本好信|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kimoto Yoshinobu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11518614}}, "On the Early Life of Fujiwara no Maro: Before the Nagaya no Hen Incident", {{ill|Kōshien Junior College Bulletin|ja|甲子園短期大学紀要}}, No. 28, March 2010. {{CRID|1390852193460906624}}.</ref>

According to one account, he passed away in exile on the 22nd day of the 6th month of {{ill|Jinki (era)|en|Jinki (era)|qid=Q1373210|lt=Shinki}} 2 (725) at the age of 73.<ref>『皇胤志』</ref>
